messages:
shreya: seeing a spike of 502s from inference-router -> customers complaining. incident-bot tried to page oncall but several folks report either duplicate SMS or no SMS at all. can someone confirm pager delivery?

pager-bot: automated: Created incident INC-2026-243 at 2026-03-17T18:12:12Z. Attempted paging via sms-provider-1 and sms-provider-2.

kai: I got two SMS and no Slack DM. looks like sms-provider-2 retried and re-sent duplicates.

daniel: I did not get any SMS. Slack paging succeeded for me.

lee: oncall here. I'm seeing pager-bot show 502s from paging gateway: `403: invalid auth` to sms-provider-1 for ~30s, then `504` from sms-provider-2.

shreya: copying runbook: https://go.runbooks/redwood/incidents/paging-integration - follow manual page section if automation failing.

kai: quick check: pager proxy auth token rotated an hour ago during deploy; rotation job shows success but gateway still using old token.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: auth-rotation-job completed. post-rotation hook returned 200.

lee: looks like post-rotation hook didn't update `pager-config` in staging cluster for the gateway. production config stuck on previous token.

shreya: mitigation - switching to manual paging fallback. who can run `scripts/manual_page.sh --team=sre --msg="INC-2026-243: oncall ack required, customers reporting API errors"`

kai: running manual_page now (using sms-provider-2). sending one consolidated SMS, then Slack DM to everyone.

pager-bot: manual pages sent to oncall group via sms-provider-2. delivery: 7/9 succeeded, 2 pending. no duplicates expected from manual flow.

daniel: for customers: added short post to status page and notified CS to open support tickets for impacted tenants. https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-243

lee: temp mitigation: pinned gateway to pre-rotation token and disabled rotation for gateway service. alert on token-mismatch suppressed until we confirm fix.

shreya: good. can infra patch the post-rotation hook to update `pager-config` and validate with a dry-run?

kai: will submit hotfix PR to infra repo: infra/pager-proxy#458. test dry-run locally with `make pager-sync-dryrun`.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: hotfix merged and staged. dry-run shows `config checksum match` for sms-provider-2, fails for sms-provider-1 due to a newline in secret.

lee: removing newline in sms-provider-1 secret, re-syncing.

kai: re-synced. pager proxy now authenticating to both providers. running controlled test: sending 3 test pages to oncall.

pager-bot: test pages: provider-1: 3/3 delivered, provider-2: 3/3 delivered.

shreya: excellent. rollback: re-enable rotation with improved validation (reject rotation if secret contains newline). scheduled additional test during next token rotation.

daniel: postmortem items: (1) rotation hook lacked validation; (2) paging automation didn't surface partial delivery failures to incident channel; (3) need dedupe logic for provider retries -> duplicate SMS. Added to backlog: https://go.tasks/redwood/INC-2026-243

lee: customer impact note: roughly 12 customers saw degraded API responses for ~17 minutes. CS notified.

shreya: thanks everyone. leaving incident open for 2h to monitor and then we'll move to postmortem. :thumbsup:
